name: Mobile guided flow, hero and persistence
description: Verifies the primary mobile planning flow is readable, navigable and durable after refresh.
steps: Open HOME and confirm the dark candlelit table photograph is the full-width hero, followed by a four-part status strip and a nine-step THE PLAN index grouped into DEFINE THE PARTY, PREPARE and HOST
Tap OPEN THE PLAN and confirm the START page clearly shows a YOUR INPUT working area with visible boxed fields, then change Total budget to 1350 and Dinner time to 5:15 PM

Use NEXT · Guests, then use the mobile navigation and confirm DEFINE THE PARTY contains Start, Guests, Menu, Experience and Table; PREPARE contains Shopping and Prep; HOST contains Schedule and Printables; and BUDGET / SPEND appears separately under UTILITY
Return to START and confirm Total budget is 1350 and Dinner time is 5:15 PM, then advance Menu → Experience → Table to confirm the new dependency order
expected: The app presents a readable nine-step Define → Prepare → Host workflow, Budget / Spend remains accessible as a separate utility, Menu advances to Experience before Table, and edited party basics persist after refresh.

name: Planning headcount follows guest status and guest type
covers: estimated expected confirmed custom planning modes
description: Verifies there is one explicit quantity source of truth and that guest-list modes derive it from RSVP records.
steps: Open GUESTS and confirm Estimated, Expected, Confirmed and Planning For totals are visible
Set Plan quantities for to Expected and confirm Planning For equals Attending plus Pending guests
Change one Pending guest to Declined and confirm Planning For drops immediately
Change an attending guest from Adult to Child and confirm the Table screen updates adult and child counts
Mark an adult No alcohol and confirm drink-glass and alcohol planning no longer assumes that guest drinks
Switch Plan quantities for to Custom, enter 10, and confirm Table, Shopping and Printables use 10 as the planning headcount
expected: Expected and Confirmed modes derive quantities from the live guest list; Custom and Estimated remain manually controlled; guest type and alcohol preference affect downstream calculations.

name: Menu, guests, table and shopping stay synchronized
description: Verifies the dependent planning systems share the same guest, menu, inventory and responsibility data.
steps: Open MENU, choose the VEGETARIAN filter and confirm tagged vegetarian recipes remain visible
Add a custom recipe named Family Cornbread using the default Type and confirm it appears in the menu without an invalid category
Assign Pumpkin pie to Sarah, then open GUESTS and change Sarah to Declined
Open SHOPPING and confirm Pumpkin pie is no longer treated as a guest-provided item and the host shopping plan includes it
Open TABLE, set Total guests to 12 and Dinner plates you have to 6, then open SHOPPING
Confirm the dinner-plate shortage is present and automatic food/table quantities reflect the 12-person plan
Increase one automatic shopping quantity, refresh, and confirm the override persists
expected: Dietary filters work, custom recipes use a valid category, declined guests cannot silently own menu items, table shortages flow into Shopping, quantities scale with guest count, and quantity overrides persist.

name: Prep and complete day schedule include non-food work
description: Verifies prep and the run of show cover the house, food, activities and custom events rather than cooking alone.
steps: Open PREP and confirm bathroom, entry, dishwasher, coffee station, trash, house reset and food-prep tasks are present
Add Put extra towels in powder room as a FINAL 60 MINUTES custom prep task
Open EXPERIENCE and select Gratitude cards and After-dinner game
Open TIMELINE and confirm the custom prep task, selected activities, house-reset tasks, dessert service and coffee service appear
Add Family photo before dinner at 4:00 PM
Turn on PARTY-DAY MODE and confirm the chronological task list is usable
expected: Prep covers whole-house readiness, schedule content includes food and non-food event work, custom tasks and activities feed the timeline, and Party-Day Mode shows the resulting run of show.

name: Guest edits drive seating and printables
description: Verifies guest data propagates into seating and printables without duplicate data entry.
steps: Open GUESTS, add Jordan, mark Jordan Attending and add Dairy-free as a dietary note
Open TABLE and assign Jordan a seat
Return to GUESTS and rename Jordan to Jordan C
Open TABLE and confirm the seat assignment follows the renamed guest
Open PRINTABLES and confirm there is a Name tag for Jordan C with the dietary note, food labels for selected menu items and activity printables for selected activities
expected: Renaming a guest preserves their seating assignment, and printables reflect the current attending guest names, dietary data, menu and activities.

name: Shopping accepts practical custom supplies and supports completion
description: Verifies the shopping list handles both suggested hosting essentials and arbitrary household items on mobile.
steps: Open SHOPPING and tap ADD for Toilet paper, Coffee and Dish soap
Add Batteries as a custom item with quantity 2 each
Mark Batteries purchased and confirm its completed state is visible
Remove Batteries and confirm it disappears
Leave the custom Item field empty and tap ADD TO SHOPPING LIST
expected: Suggested essentials can be added, custom household items can be created, completed and removed, and an empty custom item does not create a blank shopping record.
